sentences.japanese: 状況は私たちが思っていたよりも悪い。
sentences.english: The situation is worse than we believed.

sentences.japanese: 君は僕と同様、物覚えが悪い。
sentences.english: You are no better at remembering things than I am.

sentences.japanese: 君は少し休んだほうがいいと思うよ。顔色が悪いから。
sentences.english: I think you'd better take a rest; you look ill.
